experience.role: Software Engineering Manager - Technical Leadership Role
experience.description: Leading the internalization and technical audit of a legacy third-party system, gaining full ownership of architecture and codebase.
achievements: Led the internalization and technical ownership of a mission-critical public-sector platform serving 28 municipal departments, 6 government-linked organizations and the mayor’s office, taking responsibility for architecture, infrastructure, Java codebases and PostgreSQL databases previously maintained by a third-party vendor.

Defined and executed the modernization strategy for a heavily undocumented Java 8 monolithic ecosystem built with Struts2, JSP and Hibernate, supporting hundreds of thousands of users and over 6 million citizen-service records, establishing a scalable architecture for long-term evolution while maintaining uninterrupted operations.

Architected the transition from on-premises infrastructure to AWS, designing scalable, resilient and cost-optimized cloud environments using EC2, S3, IAM, CloudFront, Application Load Balancer (ALB) and multi-environment governance strategies.

Redesigned production deployment architecture using AWS Application Load Balancer (ALB) routing and blue-green deployment patterns, enabling controlled releases, rollback capabilities and reduced service disruption across business-critical citizen-service operations.

Transformed manual, day-long deployment procedures into automated CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, Docker, GHCR, build automation, automated testing, artifact promotion, CycloneDX SBOM generation, Trivy vulnerability scanning and Dockle container compliance scanning, reducing deployment execution time from approximately one day to minutes.

Migrated application delivery from manually managed Docker Compose environments to a Kubernetes-based GitOps architecture using k3s, Argo CD, Traefik and cert-manager, establishing declarative deployments, automated reconciliation, TLS management and standardized application operations.

Established reproducible Infrastructure as Code and standardized environment provisioning across development, staging and production using Terraform, Ansible and Docker, enabling complete environments to be created from scratch with a single command and improving environment consistency.

Designed and implemented a configurable Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) architecture for the legacy Java platform, integrating access profiles, functional permissions and user/sector authorization mappings, while resolving a production-blocking authentication regression rooted in a database migration failure.

Led the redesign of data and form architecture through Entity-Attribute-Value (EAV) modeling and PostgreSQL JSONB-based conditional workflow configuration, enabling flexible client-specific customization without frequent code changes or database migrations.

Designed and implemented backend services using Python, FastAPI, Node.js and RESTful API patterns, alongside React and JavaScript/TypeScript frontend applications, enabling the gradual decomposition of legacy Java capabilities and delivery of new platform features.

Architected and initiated an AI-driven conversational platform using Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, LangChain and SQLite, implementing workflow orchestration, internal API integration and natural-language citizen-service complaint registration.

Designed automated testing and workflow validation strategies for AI-driven conversational systems using pytest and API integration testing, establishing quality controls for chatbot behavior, workflow reliability and production readiness.

Engineered Python and Pandas-based metadata mining solutions for a 148-table legacy PostgreSQL database, creating the organization’s first centralized database dictionary and improving system comprehension, onboarding and query reliability across the engineering team.

Reverse engineered undocumented business rules and system behaviors from legacy Struts2/JSP applications, Hibernate mappings, PostgreSQL schemas and compiled proprietary Java JAR artifacts, translating critical operational knowledge into maintainable service-oriented solutions.

Defined and implemented the organization’s first automated testing strategy using JUnit 5, Mockito, pytest, end-to-end testing and integration testing, establishing a layered testing architecture to support safer releases and incremental modernization.

Led technical planning, architectural decisions and delivery coordination for a six-developer engineering team, applying Agile backlog management, architectural documentation, technical standards and stakeholder alignment to modernization initiatives and operational stability.

achievements: Designed, developed and maintained internal and external chatbot solutions using Python-based automation and conversational workflows, supporting operational communication and customer interaction initiatives across multiple business contexts.

Automated repetitive operational processes through Selenium-based web scraping workflows and ETL pipelines built with Python and Pandas, reducing manual effort and improving consistency of business-critical data processing activities.

Developed data extraction and transformation routines integrating multiple external sources into structured internal datasets, improving information accessibility and operational reporting capabilities for business teams.

Acted as a data liaison between leadership and technical systems by translating high-level business questions into optimized MySQL queries and actionable datasets, enabling faster and more accurate decision-making processes.
Contributed to the maintenance and evolution of production systems used by internal teams, supporting operational continuity and improving reliability of business workflows.
Analyzed operational bottlenecks and identified automation opportunities, helping reduce dependency on manual processes and improving scalability of recurring business operations.
Collaborated with business stakeholders to understand reporting and operational requirements, transforming non-technical demands into structured data solutions and automation strategies.

achievements: Designed and implemented FastAPI (Python) backend services supporting integration of AI-driven chatbot solutions for external users, enabling scalable and modular communication workflows across multiple languages.

Integrated financial and operational data from PostgreSQL databases and third-party APIs, improving consistency and accessibility of business information across backend services and chatbot interactions.
Applied software design patterns and modular architecture principles to backend services, improving maintainability, scalability and long-term extensibility of the application ecosystem.
